name: Elle
source:
An AI "born" on the Moon that has landed on Earth.
Two years ago, during an accident at NL-A, a research facility in the suburbs. She obtained an android prosthetic body and escaped.
Blending in with the humans in the city, she runs a coffee shop and a restaurant.
